build_ATSS_detector: build an ATSS single-stage detector model with backbone, neck, and bbox_head configs
run_ATSS_loss: run the ATSS detector loss computation on a batch of input images and data samples
run_ATSS_predict: run the ATSS detector predict method to get bounding box predictions from input images
run_ATSS_extract_feat: run the ATSS detector extract_feat method to get multi-level features from input images
review_ATSS_init: review the ATSS detector __init__ to understand backbone, neck, and bbox_head initialization
